detail: Full summary: All 6 regression tests were verified to FAIL against the unfixed code by stashing src/ and re-running — a test that passes without the fix pins nothing. The first version of the ordering test DID pass unfixed because the fixture's store order coincidentally matched score order; it was rewritten around confidence (an insertion-order-independent scoring input) until it discriminated. This is the same weakness the verifier identified in decision-propagation.test.ts:155.
